Fornalhas da Periferia de Vidaria: Furnaces on the Outskirts of Vidaria
A pele cinza racha com veios de magma ca: Magma splits your ash-gray skin each time your breath quickens. Vidaria's enforcers have come to reclaim their test subject. Burn everything before the rune consumes you.
Em Alisyum, todo poder exige um pagament: In Alisyum, all power exacts a price you never agreed to pay. Set your Identity Mod and equipment before entering combat.
O guardião caiu diante da sua runa. Os n: The guardian fell before your rune. The newly etched patterns now echo across the continent.
O Arconte da Fornalha se desfez em escór: The Furnace Archon crumbled into slag. The rune in your chest answers to your will alone. Vidaria's masters hold no power over it now.
Desde a primeira guerra que fundou Nosir: You have marched under the Baron's banner since the first war that founded Nosirian. Today, even the inquisitors fear the weight of your blood debt.
O Inquisidor Escarlate ajoelhou-se na pr: The Scarlet Inquisitor knelt in a pool of his own blood. The undefeated general of the first war still stands above the Pact's ruins.
Sobreviventes de Crolbia não confiam em: Crolbia's survivors bend the odds past human limits. Set your dice and prepare the table.
Todas as cartas caíram a seu favor no la: Every card fell your way on the final play. Across Crolbia and Abar, no one dares bet against a hand at over 300% odds.
O gelo consciente de Illana reconstruiu: Illana's living ice rebuilt your bones. You shattered the crown that demanded submission, and every shard in your shield now cuts back.
O Carcereiro Vítreo estilhaçou-se diante: The Vitreous Jailer shattered against your unyielding wall. Freed from the divine bond, you carry the eternal cold by choice.
A fenda na pedra se abre revelando moeda: The stone splits open to reveal ancient Pact coins.
Entre cinzas antigas repousa uma pia rún: A rune basin lies warm among old ashes. Offer gold to recover or break the seals to collect shards.
Um marco de guerra escarlate oferece tes: A scarlet war marker offers ancient riches to whoever seals the stone with their blood.
Quebrar o selo: ganhar +2 Fragmentos Rún: Break the seal to gain 2 Runic Shards
Equipe seu Mod de Identidade inicial e s: Equip your starting Identity Mod and gear.
